basic.name: Frost Shot
basic.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Pela's ATK to a single target enemy.

skill.name: Frostbite
skill.description_template: Removes 1 buff(s) and deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Pela's ATK to one designated target enemy.

ultimate.name: Zone Suppression
ultimate.description_template: Deals Ice DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Pela's ATK to all enemies, with a 100% base chance to inflict Exposed on all enemies. When Exposed, enemies' DEF is reduced by {{scaling2}}% for 2 turn(s).

talent.name: Data Collecting
talent.description_template: If the enemy is debuffed after Pela's attack, Pela will restore {{scaling1}} additional Energy. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per attack.

technique.name: Preemptive Strike
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. Upon entering battle, Pela deals Ice DMG equal to 80% of her ATK to a random enemy, with a 100% base chance of lowering the DEF of all enemies by 20% for 2 turn(s).

2.name: Bash
2.description: Deals 20% more DMG to debuffed enemy targets.

4.name: The Secret Strategy
4.description: When Pela is on the battlefield, all allies' Effect Hit Rate increases by 10%.

6.name: Wipe Out
6.description: When using Skill to dispel buff(s), increases the DMG dealt by the next attack by 20%.

eidolons.name: Victory Report
eidolons.description: When an enemy is defeated, Pela regenerates 5 Energy.

eidolons.name: Adamant Charge
eidolons.description: Using Skill to dispel buff(s) increases SPD by 10% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Suppressive Force
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Full Analysis
eidolons.description: When using Skill, there is a 100% base chance to reduce the target enemy's Ice RES by 12% for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Absolute Jeopardy
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Feeble Pursuit
eidolons.description: After Pela attacks, if the enemy target is debuffed, deals Ice Additional DMG equal to 40% of Pela's ATK to the enemy.
